commands: C:/Users/E-ngineers/.gemini/bin/agy.exe --print "Open the image <name> in this folder. It is a trading platform screenshot. Reply with ONLY a JSON object {position, entry, stop, target}; use null for any value you cannot read, null is a valid answer." --model gemini-4-argon-low   (run with cwd = the scratch agy_in folder, once per frame and crop)

goal: Know whether Argon (gemini-4-argon-low) reads the 7 hard Tom frames better than Flash, and settle 25200 vs 25206 (k0zm_1510_1720) and the T6hDJcHrVBM_0550 stop from larger crops.
note: [weight=IMPORTANT class=C0 lab-touch=no worker=session] Follow-up of the 2026-10-18 Flash pilot (MyTradingSys/research/lab_guy/pilots/2026-10-18_gemini_frame_read/). steps: Make a scratch folder agy_in; copy the 7 frames listed in the pilot README from F:/MTS/data/tom_videos/frames; crop k0zm_1510_1720.png into its top and bottom panels and make 2x crops of the stop/target labels for k0zm and T6hDJcHrVBM_0550 (PIL)
For each frame/crop run from agy_in (command below; no claim in the prompt, null is a valid answer; never --dangerously-skip-permissions)
Compare outputs to the audit truth table in the pilot json in code; a number for a hidden field = invented; write results_argon-low.json and add Argon vs Flash counts to the pilot README
For 25200 vs 25206 and the 0550 stop report the crop reads; if Argon disagrees with itself or Flash mark CONTESTED for a human read, do not pick one

title: Run Argon blind-read with null option on the 7 Gemini-pilot frames; settle 25200 vs 25206 and the T6hDJcHrVBM_0550 stop from a larger crop
